title: Complete American and International Checkers with full six-piece bots
body:
American 8×8 and International 10×10 Checkers now have a complete deterministic core, forced captures and multi-jumps, kings, draw handling, hot-seat play, and easy/medium/strong bots backed by the complete licensed 2–6-piece databases.

The accepted offline page is 1,390,845,993 bytes. Its first 968-MB ZIP exceeded the connector's actual 512-MiB download limit, so delivery now publishes four individually bounded artifacts with an identical source-bound manifest, receipt and standard-library Python JOIN helper. All four actual downloaded ZIPs were independently checked against GitHub's official size/digest; every member/CRC, helper, part order/offset/size/SHA and streamed complete page SHA passed. Download and extract the four `G10-standalone-part-00` through `03` artifacts from the accepted run, then run `python3 standalone-parts.py join standalone-parts.json play.html`. Actions artifacts expire after seven days; the tracked play.html remains the older 2–5-piece baseline.

Validation on exact head `ae36b497cfd474f0eafc873bb2489b2529b4163e`: [full workflow 37845153145](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37845153145), all four original stages and final delivery SUCCESS. Independent complete reader closed PASS at 2026-10-08 21:38:19.877 UTC: all 349 guarded inputs, exact head/run/attempt/runtime/commands, 91 tests, 25 actual mutant kills, 7,000 configuration games, 1,003 property seeds, 10,000 independent move cases, all 4,000 true-terminal strength games and 80 gold-identical raw files, all 2,400 native frame intervals and 2,404 timestamps across both boards/desktop/phone 4×, and genuine decoded International gameplay captures. Delivery controls passed 4 positives and rejected 21 corruptions. Separate actual downloaded-parts reader closed PASS at 21:37:29.277522 UTC; complete HTML SHA-256 `5ed2173b7264574565dd29ff14773236cac5a00833bf75df3de9e64a66451801`.

The genuine earlier local International 17.510-FPS failure and phone NOTRUN, missing-probe CI failures, omitted-checksum checkpoint, omitted-command integration failure and cadence misses remain preserved with their exact historical scopes. A different hosted run does not establish the cause of that local frame failure. This PR is a draft for the binding post-green KEEP GOING review; no rounds or completion are claimed yet.
